fields.headline: Approves $19.6M in January 2021 payroll checks and direct deposits
fields.summary: The board approves January 2021 payroll for the 2020-2021 fiscal year: 757 payroll checks printed and 6,727 direct deposits made, totaling $19,572,926.82. The official text repeats the accounts payable wording from item 21-0338 (570 checks, $31,188,979.04), but the attached cover memo and Payroll Summary report show the payroll figures used here. The full report is Exhibit 1 to the item.

21-0339.note: The amount was corrected from $31,188,979.04 (repeated from the accounts payable item) to $19,572,926.82, the payroll total in the attached memo.
21-0339.sourceIssue: The title names Payroll Warrants and Direct Deposit, but the action text describes Accounts Payable Warrants (570 checks, $31,188,979.04), the same wording as item 21-0338; the attached memo gives 757 payroll checks and 6,727 direct deposits totaling $19,572,926.82.
